pairs_with_note: This manifest holds the Metrale Engine leg only. The vLLM legs it is compared against are the series of pairs_with (vllm-mtp for throughput, vllm-mtp-energy for joules), and are not restated here. A reader pairs the subject below with those series axis by axis: the same checkpoint, ISL 128 / OSL 1024 essay instrument, ctx 2048, batch cap 128, bf16 KV, thinking off, the same box, and the same harness revision as vllm-mtp-energy.

reps_note: 2 timed reps + 1 warmup per rung. The vLLM legs in published.json ran 3 timed reps + 1 warmup. The rep count is a sample count, not an instrument axis: every rep sends the same requests. It is disclosed here rather than matched.

series.source_note: Two legs, one fresh serve each, stopped by PID: C=32/64/128 on 2026-09-29 23:06-23:23 UTC, then C=1..16 23:31-23:37 UTC. The rung files are the harness output split by rung. Only `label` differs from the harness JSON (renamed after the rung file); every rep, every other top-level field and every value are as written. sha256: metrale_moe_energy_c1_16.json f533a07f0844c6cdde827fe27b23919b522f931029f8113df35461653f419abc, metrale_moe_energy_c32.json ed34d383e99d2a177a27057d8ffc0c59e23f8a6b7c5c2d1f82239d9d0d0eacd2, metrale_moe_energy_c64.json cd3ff1dfcf5fc062e9625705eed6afa56c2db9ed0d76f63c026e49c565834a30, metrale_moe_energy_c128.json 347dc0393fd738adc3ba6edb0e05adb692a8011cc81821bbf7e0d2d2bdc152e8. Zero request errors. Every rep is gpu_rail_trustworthy. A 10 Hz NVML total-energy sidecar ran beside both legs as a cross-check on the in-window figure.
series.evidence_note: Published-ladder data, not a gate record. The concurrency-sweep-moe gate covers C=1..16, and its signed records under .benchmarks/ remain the certified evidence for those rungs. C=32/64/128 exist only here.
